finding_1_tnb_audit_DAILY_slot_is_gated_.mechanism: First successful claim in a given week holds the key for ~8 days. Every subsequent DAILY run that week hits `if PUBLISH_CLAIM.claimed != true` and EXITs with 'DONE: duplicate-publish blocked | PIPELINE: complete | QUALITY: full'. A daily audit degrades to weekly, and the exit string reports it as a COMPLETE, FULL-QUALITY run — so the degradation is invisible to anything reading pipeline status.

finding_2_ONE_STUCK_NEW_ROW_DEFEATS_THE_.claim: cowork-tick-preflight.sh's SILENT gate is `slots empty AND one_shots empty AND signal_queue NEW == 0` (script header line 25). A single permanently-NEW signal_queue row therefore forces verdict=WORK on EVERY tick, including ticks with nothing whatsoever to dispatch.
finding_2_ONE_STUCK_NEW_ROW_DEFEATS_THE_.observed: Tick 2026-07-21T20:30Z returned verdict=WORK with slots=0, one_shots=0, new_signals=1. There was no work. The full LLM continuation path ran anyway.
finding_2_ONE_STUCK_NEW_ROW_DEFEATS_THE_.the_stuck_row: po-20260720T052606 (ts 2026-07-20T05:26:06Z, to=unified-agent, type=methodology-flag, severity=HIGH). Queue histogram: 75 rows = 1 NEW + 73 triaged + 1 RETRACTED. It is the ONLY NEW row and has been for 39.2h.
finding_2_ONE_STUCK_NEW_ROW_DEFEATS_THE_.why_it_is_stuck: unified-agent has no signal_queue reader, so the row is undeliverable; PO recorded it as LEFT NEW deliberately (po-s148). That decision is defensible on its own terms — the row should not be marked READ by an agent that never read it. The cost was almost certainly not foreseen: it silently disables a token-economy optimization in a different subsystem.
finding_2_ONE_STUCK_NEW_ROW_DEFEATS_THE_.cost: The preflight's stated purpose (main.md:49-51) is 'on the common SILENT/WORK path this replaces the LLM-narrated Steps 0a-4b entirely (~80% of ticks are silent off-hours/no-due-work; this cuts that to one bash call + a short JSON reply)'. With a permanently-NEW row that ~80% saving is zero. Every no-work tick pays the full LLM path.
finding_2_ONE_STUCK_NEW_ROW_DEFEATS_THE_.quantification_refused: 39.2h is 157 wall-clock */15 ticks, but executed ticks are FEWER and NOT derivable — the dispatcher only fires while a live CLI session exists and 07-20 had no session from ~09:15Z onward (project_cowork_guaranteed_slot_needs_live_cli_session). Reporting 157 as the cost would be the same last_fired-style overclaim that file already documents. The mechanism is certain; the magnitude is not measured here.
finding_2_ONE_STUCK_NEW_ROW_DEFEATS_THE_.same_class_as: feedback_dispatcher_telemetry_writes_deadlock_inbox_backlog_guard and feedback_composite_score_masks_dead_detector_pruned_table — a gate whose input has a permanent floor above/below its threshold stops discriminating while still reporting that it fired. Third instance of this family in this subsystem.
finding_2_ONE_STUCK_NEW_ROW_DEFEATS_THE_.fix_direction_PLAN_ONLY: Do NOT resolve this by flipping the row to READ — that launders an undelivered signal and is exactly what PO refused. Candidates: (a) make the SILENT gate count only rows that are ROUTABLE this tick (addressed to an agent with a due slot), so an undeliverable row stops forcing WORK; (b) give the queue a terminal UNDELIVERABLE status distinct from NEW, so a known-dead row leaves the NEW population without being falsely marked read; (c) fix delivery to unified-agent, which closes the root cause and is already owned. Owner: po/agents-architect. The dispatcher must not unilaterally change queue semantics.
finding_2_ONE_STUCK_NEW_ROW_DEFEATS_THE_.severity: MED — no incorrect output, pure waste; but it is a self-inflicted, permanently-on cost with a single-row cause.
